ns2:course.label: Welding and Joining Processes
ns2:course.description: The physical principles of fusion welding; heat flow; thermal cycles; physical metallurgy and mechanical properties of welded joints; applications of welding to large structures; testing of welds; nondestructive testing; design, economics, and weld specifications; and laboratory experiments in welding. Same as CEE 400. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: TAM 324 or TAM 206 or equivalent.
